$$U_x = \operatorname{Spec} k[x, y/x], \quad V_u = \operatorname{Spec} k[x/y,\, y^2/x], \quad V_y = \operatorname{Spec} k[x/y^2,\, y].$$

$$Z = V(x^2,\, xy,\, y^3) \;\subset\; \mathbb{A}^2,$$

defined by the ideal $(x^2, xy, y^3) \subset k[x,y]$.

This is a **non-reduced subscheme** (a fat point) supported at the origin. Its coordinate ring is

$$k[x,y]/(x^2,\, xy,\, y^3),$$
